Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks for picking this up. Our product team in Chicago (US Central) would like a deep-dive demo next week that includes Redwood's EU engineering pair for technical Q&A. Ideal time for our side is 09:00–11:00 CT, but we understand that spans late evening for EU folks.

Two asks:
- Can we find a time that keeps Redwood engineers within reasonable hours (no later than 21:30 CEST)?
- If not, can we run a live 60–75 minute session with a clean recording + a 30-minute follow-up async summary for EU engineers?

Proposed days: Tue 2026-05-26 or Thu 2026-05-28. Open to suggestions.

Quick note: we are sensitive to DST oddities — our calendar sometimes shows the whole team in CT while EU attendees see CEST shift. Please confirm explicit times in both zones when you reply.

Best,
Samantha

Hi Samantha — thanks, this is doable. A couple quick items and a contingency plan below.

1) Time sanity check (explicit):
   - 09:00 CT = 16:00 CEST (same calendar day) — this looks workable for EU engineers (under 21:30), but note Europe will still be observing CEST in late May.
   - 10:00 CT = 17:00 CEST (also okay)

2) Proposed primary slot: Tue 2026-05-26 at 10:00 CT / 17:00 CEST — 75 minutes live, followed by a 30-minute optional deep-dive for engineers who can stay.

3) Contingency (if EU engineers cannot attend live):
   - Run the 75-minute session with an engineer rotation (EU joins first 45 mins for architecture/Q&A, US runs product walkthrough).
   - Record the full meeting, and we will publish a 10-minute highlights clip + a timestamped Q&A doc within 8 business hours.
   - Offer an optional async 30-minute Q&A thread and a scheduled 30-minute follow-up sync at a time convenient to EU (we can propose 09:00 CEST next day).

4) I attached a concise agenda and a small .ics with three proposed slots (two live + one fallback). I also added Tom to keep procurement in the loop given this is a POC.

Please confirm whether Tue 10:00 CT / 17:00 CEST works, or suggest the other slot in the attached .ics.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Soojin to capture recording and the follow-up runbook if we lock it.

—Marissa

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 08:10:00 +02:00
Subject: Internal: DST / timezone gotcha and ops note

Marissa / Soojin — quick internal note before we finalize: Europe is on CEST (+02:00) now; US Central is CDT (-05:00). That makes 10:00 CT = 17:00 CEST (correct). The gotcha often happens when recipients in different calendar apps interpret timezones differently around DST transition weeks — recommend these ops knobs:

- Put both explicit times in the invite body (e.g., "Tue 2026-05-26 10:00 CT / 17:00 CEST / 00:00 AEST") instead of relying on the calendar converter alone.
- Set the meeting organizer's timezone to CT and add a secondary timezone marker as part of the event title (e.g., "(10:00 CT / 17:00 CEST)").
- Enable automatic recording and pin the recording notice in the top of the calendar description to satisfy procurement.
- Plan for an engineer rotation: EU lead covers first 45 minutes for architecture, US product team covers features next 30. Means max live time for EU is 90 minutes.

I will prepare the brief runbook for Soojin (recording handoff, highlight clip, timestamped Q&A doc).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solution Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
